user.title: Dashboard History
user.description: Records every change to your dashboards and lets you put back what disappeared. Nothing to fill in here: the history starts with the first save after setup. What it marks by itself can be changed later under Configure.

abort.already_configured: Dashboard History is already set up. One instance records every dashboard.

init.title: Dashboard History
init.description: A version marks a state you can come back to by name.

data.daily_versions: Mark the state at the end of each day

data_description.daily_versions: On the first change of a new day, the state that was there before it is marked as a version, named after the day it belongs to. Turn this off to stop those daily marks. Each dashboard still gets one v1.0.0 when the integration first sees it, so there is always a state to come back to. Nothing is deleted either way: every state stays in the history, marked or not.
